title: Deeper/broader Background consumer and carrier-boundary review
mode: primary-source contract review plus local generated implementation controls

sources.scope: DXF OBJECTS dictionary key/child handle example
ACAD_BACKGROUND dictionary, unique names, Background subclass hierarchy, and no sharing among viewports
VIEWPORT group 332 Background and distinct groups 333/348/361 references
IBL secondary-background API and allowed Solid/Gradient/Image class set
Independent published DWG object field-model cross-check; not treated as normative or semantic acceptance

behavior: Same-source-revision AC1021-AC1032 Background records require a unique NOD ACAD_BACKGROUND dictionary with exact typed/raw pair, owner, kind, and handle identity.

VIEW, VPORT, and VIEWPORT group-332 references require rooted Background targets and use remapped handles; direct low-level codec calls are fail-closed unless the target set is registered by the adapter.
VPORT and VIEWPORT Background references are counted as viewport owners and duplicate target ownership rejects; VIEW references are resolved but are not counted as viewport owners.

IBL group-340 edges require exact typed/raw handle agreement and a distinct, unique ACAD_BACKGROUND target of class Solid, Gradient, or Image; duplicate IBL ownership and direct view/viewport references to the assumed-owned target reject.
Raw IBL group-340 edges replay through handle remapping; direct typed IBL writes require a registered target and Skylight-to-SUN writes remain fail-closed.
Common reactors/extension dictionaries and the standalone SUN owner graph remain fail-closed.
Corrected field comments that identified Background DXF group 332 as DWG-only or used a wrong group number.
generatedControls: ASCII/Binary generated controls round-trip all six Background types with ACAD_BACKGROUND root/owner and an IBL-to-Solid group-340 edge.
ASCII/Binary generated variants round-trip IBL-to-Gradient and IBL-to-Image edges and verify the target handle after readback.
ASCII/Binary generated controls round-trip VIEW and VPORT group-332 references and a VIEWPORT group-332 reference to a distinct rooted Background.

An unrooted VIEWPORT target, VPORT+VIEWPORT shared target, duplicate VPORT ownership, missing root, cross-revision replay, IBL-to-GroundPlane/unrooted target, duplicate IBL owner, direct consumer of the assumed-owned target, typed/raw IBL edge mismatch, unpaired raw carrier, and SUN owner graph remain fail-closed; output sentinel is preserved on graph refusal.
Direct low-level DXF writer controls reject an unregistered IBL secondary-background edge and an unclosed Skylight-to-SUN edge in ASCII and Binary.

focusedResults: All seven named focused DXF controls passed; VPORT shade-plot negative vectors printed expected parser diagnostics.

The positive VIEWPORT group-332 path, IBL-to-Solid/Gradient/Image group-340 variants, and all new unrooted/disallowed/direct-consumer/typed-raw negative controls pass in generated ASCII and Binary DXF.
Direct low-level IBL/SUN fail-closed controls pass in both encodings.

assessment.researchConclusion: Rooted Background graph preservation, all three group-332 consumer slots, and the documented IBL group-340 Solid/Gradient/Image secondary-edge matrix are implemented for exact same-version replay. The external references establish wire/object structure, not rendering or semantic 3D support.
assessment.remaining: Native producer/consumer qualification of the IBL edge; common reactor/extension-dictionary closure; exact SUN and Skylight ownership; independent DXF and native consumer qualification.
